method.mode: all languages; low accuracy; minimum relative distance 0.15
method.input: SKILL.md prose, excluding front matter, code blocks, inline code, URLs and paths
method.mixed: English and Chinese each >=40 letters and >=20% of all prose letters; combined >=80%; at least 3 English function words in English-detected spans
method.other: A detected dominant language other than English or Chinese
method.unknown: Too little prose or no confident dominant language; remains in denominator

limitations: Automatic text classification, not an independent human language audit.
Language refers to SKILL.md prose, not repository programming language or bundled files.
Quoted examples and multilingual instructions can affect automatic labels.
